title: Burger King Corporation Terms & Conditions
slide_intent: Separate permission to use a brand from knowledge of its design so readers understand the limits of the reference.
strategic_value: Explicit review and territorial conditions can help Burger King keep partner execution accountable.
demonstration: A left notice introduces two narrower columns of terms on a cream field.
practical_value: Check authorization, market-specific marks and approval requirements before treating examples as reusable assets.

content_islands.name: Notice
content_islands.spec: Place the heading and opening condition in the left column.

content_islands.name: Terms
content_islands.spec: Set the authorized-use, territorial trademark, review and return conditions in two columns to the right.

reference_purposes.Constraint: The terms restrict authorized use, require review and approvals, and distinguish registered marks by territory.
